items_flat.title_en: OpenAI starts EU text watermarking, with detector limited to researchers
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 啟動歐盟文字浮水印，偵測器僅限研究人員
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it is expanding content provenance to text to meet the EU AI Act. API customers worldwide can opt in today for select models; watermarking stays off by default. Over the coming weeks, eligible ChatGPT and Codex text in the EU will carry an invisible textGrain signal. Detector access starts with approved researchers and expert organizations.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示因應歐盟 AI 法案，把內容溯源擴及文字。全球 API 客戶即日起可對部分模型選擇加入，預設關閉。未來數週，歐盟符合資格的 ChatGPT 與 Codex 文字將嵌入不可見的 textGrain 訊號。偵測器先開放核准的研究人員與專業機構申請。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a compliance rollout, not a solved provenance system: OpenAI’s own tests show synonym edits can collapse detection, from about 92% to 17% when 25% of words are replaced. Restricting the detector avoids a public false-positive tool, but it also means EU users cannot check outputs themselves yet.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是合規上線，不是已解決的溯源系統：OpenAI 自己的測試顯示同義詞改寫會讓偵測崩掉，替換 25% 詞彙時約從 92% 降到 17%。限制偵測器可避免公開誤判工具，但歐盟使用者目前仍無法自行查核輸出。
items_flat.quote: Starting today, API customers globally will be able to opt in to text watermarking for select models. Text watermarking will remain off by default in the API.
items_flat.quote_zh: 即日起，全球 API 客戶可對部分模型選擇加入文字浮水印。API 中的文字浮水印預設維持關閉。

items_flat.title_en: Nvidia-backed Reflection unveils Beam, a 501B open-weight model
items_flat.title_zh: 輝達支持的 Reflection 公布 501B 開源權重模型 Beam
items_flat.summary_en: Reflection AI introduced Beam, its first open-weight model: a text-only mixture-of-experts with 501 billion total parameters and 23 billion active, a 1 million token context, and pretraining on 23.8 trillion tokens. The company says it is competitive with Z.ai’s GLM-5.2 on coding and agentic work at lower inference compute. Weights under Apache 2.0, plus the technical report, are promised later this month; the model is still in red-teaming, with early access by waitlist.
items_flat.summary_zh: Reflection AI 推出首個開源權重模型 Beam：純文字混合專家，總參數 5010 億、每次啟動 230 億，上下文 100 萬 token，預訓練 23.8 兆 token。公司稱在程式與代理任務上可與 Z.ai 的 GLM-5.2 競爭，且推理算力更低。Apache 2.0 權重與技術報告預計本月稍晚釋出；目前仍在紅隊測試，早期使用須登記候補。
items_flat.analysis_en: Beam is a Western open-weight answer aimed at Chinese models, but the performance claims are the lab’s own and the weights are not downloadable yet. Nvidia backing and a prior Colossus 2 compute deal make the compute story real; independent benches will matter more than the launch post.
items_flat.analysis_zh: Beam 是對準中國開源模型的西方開源權重回應，但成績是實驗室自報，權重也還不能下載。輝達支持與先前 Colossus 2 算力合作讓算力故事較具體；獨立評測會比發布文更重要。
items_flat.quote: We will release the weights, technical report, model card, and developer artifacts later this month.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們將於本月稍晚釋出權重、技術報告、模型卡與開發者產物。

items_flat.title_en: NYC Council presses OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta on catastrophic AI risk
items_flat.title_zh: 紐約市議會質詢 OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 與 Meta 的災難性 AI 風險
items_flat.summary_en: The New York City Council held an oversight hearing on Monday with representatives from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google and Meta. Lawmakers asked how firms quantify a worst-case catastrophic scenario, whether they carry insurance, and whether a kill switch could stop a model that fails a safety review. OpenAI’s Morgan Dwyer said she did not know the probability and that 1%, 10% or 20% would all be unacceptable; Speaker Julie Menin called the answer flippant. Ahead of the hearing, OpenAI’s Chan Park wrote offering Daybreak cybersecurity cooperation.
items_flat.summary_zh: 紐約市議會週一舉行 AI 監督聽證，OpenAI、Anthropic、Google 與 Meta 代表出席。議員追問各公司如何量化最壞災難情境、是否投保，以及安全審查未過時能否用「終止開關」停掉模型。OpenAI 的 Morgan Dwyer 表示不知道機率，並稱 1%、10% 或 20% 都不可接受；議長 Julie Menin 批評此答輕率。聽證前 OpenAI 的 Chan Park 去信，提出透過 Daybreak 資安計畫合作。
items_flat.analysis_en: The hearing shows city-level oversight filling a gap left by federal self-regulation talk, but it produced no new safety commitment or quantified risk figure from the labs. A local kill-switch bill would still depend on technical controls the companies did not describe.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這場聽證顯示市級監督想補上聯邦自我管制的空隙，但各大廠沒有提出新的安全承諾或量化風險數字。地方「終止開關」法案仍取決於各公司未說明的技術控制。
items_flat.quote: I don’t know. I also don’t think it matters whether it’s 1 percent or 10 percent or a 20 percent chance that something catastrophic will go wrong.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我不知道。我也不認為災難出錯的機率是 1%、10% 還是 20% 有什麼差別。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI tests visual ChatGPT ads and expands measurement partners
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 測試 ChatGPT 視覺廣告並擴大衡量夥伴
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said it will test a new visual ad format during image generation in ChatGPT, clearly labeled and kept separate from the generated image. US testing with an initial advertiser group starts later this month. It also expanded conversion and attribution partners, including Hightouch, Tealium, LiveRamp, AppsFlyer and others, and started brand-suitability pilots with DoubleVerify and IAS. OpenAI cited 1.2 billion weekly ChatGPT users.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 表示將在 ChatGPT 生圖過程測試新的視覺廣告格式，廣告會清楚標示並與生成圖分開。美國測試於本月稍晚、由首批廣告主開始。公司同時擴大轉換與歸因夥伴，包括 Hightouch、Tealium、LiveRamp、AppsFlyer 等，並與 DoubleVerify、IAS 啟動品牌適配試點。OpenAI 稱 ChatGPT 每週觸及 12 億人。
items_flat.analysis_en: The format change puts ads next to a creative action, which is a larger surface than text placements, but the test is still US-only and later this month. Partner case studies are not independent audits of whether answers stay uninfluenced.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 格式把廣告放在創作動作旁，版面比文字廣告更大，但測試仍限美國且要到本月稍晚。夥伴案例不是「回答是否不受廣告影響」的獨立稽核。
items_flat.quote: Initially, we’ll test this new ad format during image generation in ChatGPT. Ads will be clearly labeled, and remain separate from the image being created.
items_flat.quote_zh: 初期我們會在 ChatGPT 生圖過程測試這項新廣告格式。廣告會清楚標示，並與正在生成的圖片分開。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI adds in-product HIPAA BAA flow for eligible API orgs
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI 為符合資格的 API 組織加上產品內 HIPAA BAA 流程
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI’s API changelog for Oct 5 says eligible organization admins can accept a standard Business Associate Agreement and enable HIPAA compliance support in Organization settings. Coverage still depends on eligibility, covered services, and configuration requirements in the Help Center.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI 10 月 5 日 API 更新日誌表示，符合資格的組織管理員可在組織設定中接受標準商業夥伴協議（BAA）並啟用 HIPAA 合規支援。實際涵蓋仍取決於資格、涵蓋服務與說明中心的設定要求。
items_flat.analysis_en: The practical change is contracting friction, not a new clinical model. Healthcare buyers still have to confirm which endpoints and ChatGPT plans are actually eligible before sending protected health information.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 實際改變的是簽約摩擦，不是新的臨床模型。醫療買家在傳送受保護健康資訊前，仍須確認哪些端點與 ChatGPT 方案真的符合資格。
items_flat.quote: Admins of eligible organizations can now accept the standard Business Associate Agreement (BAA) and enable HIPAA compliance support for their organization.
items_flat.quote_zh: 符合資格組織的管理員現在可以接受標準商業夥伴協議（BAA），並為其組織啟用 HIPAA 合規支援。
